title: Spicy Lentil Bowl
description: A twist on traditional Japanese cuisine, this spicy lentil bowl combines the warmth of Korean chili flakes with the comfort of a hearty bowl.
instructions: Rinse the lentils and cook according to package instructions.
In a small pan, toast the Korean chili flakes over medium heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce and a splash of water to create a dressing.
Add the cooked lentils to the bowl and toss with the dressing.
Top with crushed plantain chips and toasted Korean chili flakes.
